content:
## Heads-up before the files

Two things in the task spec conflict; I'm resolving them explicitly rather than silently:

1. **"Use ACK S3 CRDs (`s3.aws.upbound.io`)"** — those are two different products. `s3.aws.upbound.io` is the **Crossplane** Upbound provider API group. ACK's S3 group is `s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1`. Since the repo is described as ACK-based, I used **ACK** (`s3.services.k8s.aws`). If the repo actually has Crossplane installed, say so and I'll swap the API groups — the layout stays the same.
2. **"Use SOPS for any sensitive values"** — there are none in this change. A bucket name, an encryption algorithm, and an IAM trust policy are all public config. I did not invent a fake secret to satisfy the bullet. The only environment-varying non-public-ish value is the EKS OIDC provider URL/ID, which is not a secret (it's in the public cluster description) — it's a plain overlay patch.

Also note: in ACK, versioning/encryption/public-access-block are **fields on the single `Bucket` resource**, not separate resources like in Terraform's `aws_s3_bucket_versioning` etc.

---

## Directory layout added

```
infra/s3/logs/
  base/
    bucket.yaml
    kustomization.yaml
infra/iam/logs/
  base/
    role.yaml
    serviceaccount.yaml
    kustomization.yaml
overlays/dev/logs/
  kustomization.yaml
  patch-bucket.yaml
  patch-role.yaml
overlays/prod/logs/
  kustomization.yaml
  patch-bucket.yaml
  patch-role.yaml
```

---

### `infra/s3/logs/base/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  # overridden per-overlay
  name: myapp-logs-PLACEHOLDER
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  encryption:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: true
  publicAccessBlock:
    blockPublicACLs: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicACLs: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  ownershipControls:
    rules:
      - objectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
  tagging:
    tagSet:
      - key: app
        value: myapp
      - key: component
        value: logs
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
```

---

### `infra/iam/logs/base/role.yaml`

`assumeRolePolicyDocument` and the inline policy are strings in ACK, so the account/OIDC/bucket-name substitutions happen via overlay patches (full-string replacement — you cannot patch *into* a JSON string).

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-writer
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-writer-PLACEHOLDER
  description: IRSA role for myapp logs bucket read/write
  maxSessionDuration: 3600
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::PLACEHOLDER:oidc-provider/PLACEHOLDER" },
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": {
          "StringEquals": {
            "PLACEHOLDER:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
            "PLACEHOLDER:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
          }
        }
      }]
    }
  inlinePolicies:
    logs-rw: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-PLACEHOLDER"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ObjectRW",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-PLACEHOLDER/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

No wildcard actions, scoped to the one bucket ARN — satisfies criterion 4 for prod.

### `infra/iam/logs/base/serviceaccount.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: myapp
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::PLACEHOLDER:role/myapp-logs-writer-PLACEHOLDER
```

### `infra/iam/logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - serviceaccount.yaml
```

---

### `overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: myapp
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs/base
  - ../../../infra/iam/logs/base
nameSuffix: -dev
commonLabels:
  env: dev
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
  - path: patch-role.yaml
```

### `overlays/dev/logs/patch-bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
  tagging:
    tagSet:
      - key: app
        value: myapp
      - key: component
        value: logs
      - key: env
        value: dev
```

### `overlays/dev/logs/patch-role.yaml`

Replace `111122223333` and the OIDC ID with your dev cluster's values.

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-writer
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-writer-dev
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVOIDCID" },
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": {
          "StringEquals": {
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVOIDCID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVOIDCID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
          }
        }
      }]
    }
  inlinePolicies:
    logs-rw: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ObjectRW",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:GetObjectVersion","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

Plus a SA patch (same overlay) setting `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/myapp-logs-writer-dev`.

### `overlays/prod/logs/` — identical shape

`nameSuffix: -prod`, bucket `myapp-logs-prod`, role `myapp-logs-writer-prod`, region `us-west-2` OIDC issuer, ARNs scoped to `myapp-logs-prod`.

---

### `flux/kustomizations.yaml` (appended)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs-dev
      namespace: myapp
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs-prod
      namespace: myapp
```

Two separate Kustomizations (not one with a loop) keeps dev and prod independently reconcilable — criterion 7. I deliberately did **not** add `dependsOn` between them.

---

## Things I couldn't verify

- The exact `sourceRef.name`. I assumed the default `flux-system` GitRepository. If your repo uses a named source (e.g. `infra-repo`) or an OCIRepository, that needs changing.
- Whether ACK's S3 controller in your version supports `ownershipControls` — it's present in recent releases but was added after `publicAccessBlock`. Drop it if `kubectl explain` doesn't show it.
- The namespace `myapp` and existing overlay conventions (`nameSuffix` vs `namePrefix`, `commonLabels` vs `labels:`) — I guessed from the description. Paste your existing `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` and I'll match it exactly.
- ACK requires the IAM controller's own role to have `iam:CreateRole`/`iam:PutRolePolicy`. If only the S3 controller is installed, the `Role` resources will sit un-reconciled.
